title: MAC FM · Saturday 3 October 2026
description: Good morning, MAC Fellas, and welcome to another quick radio edition. That is right, starting off with LATAM Cargo noting a 150 percent surge in Europe-Brazil pharma traffic, driven by GLP-1 drugs. Which points to heightened demand for temperature-controlled capacity on transatlantic lanes, something worth watching for yield optimization. Moving on to Flydubai Cargo, they launched a scheduled freighter network with three B737s targeting regional trade and e-commerce. That dedicated narrowbody capacity might reshape regional competition and routing options for forwarders. Finally, Cathay Cargo rolled out AI-assisted screening for cargo handling at their terminals. That tech adoption could improve handling efficiency and processing times as an operational benchmark. That is all for today. Catch you next time.
